meta.title: The Three Little Pigs
meta.author: Joseph Jacobs
meta.blurb: Three little pigs go out to seek their fortune and build three houses: one of straw, one of furze, one of brick. Then a wolf comes knocking, and he is very good at blowing.
meta.mood: Huffing, puffing, and a pot on the fire
meta.caption: “he built his house with them”

segments.speaker: host
segments.text: England, eighteen-ninety. A folklorist named Joseph Jacobs gathers up the tales that English children already knew by heart, and prints them for the first time in one book.
phrases: England, eighteen-ninety.

segments.text: The Three Little Pigs.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Once upon a time when pigs spoke rhyme, and monkeys chewed tobacco, and hens took snuff to make them tough, and ducks went quack, quack, quack, O!

segments.text: There was an old sow with three little pigs, and as she had not enough to keep them, she sent them out to seek their fortune. The first that went off met a man with a bundle of straw, and said to him:
